motor_papers.description: Technical literature, equations, and design constraints for BOTH axial flux (rotary) and linear (translational) PCB motors, covering pole pitch, track width, and multi-layer winding topologies.

tauri-docs.description: Official Tauri framework architecture, IPC commands, state management, and configuration specs. Reference this to verify API structures and command syntax.

pcbmotorgen-routing-docs.description: API documentation for consuming the pcbmotorgen routing crate handling routing patterns and DFM constraints.

pcbmotorgen-export-docs.description: API documentation for consuming the pcbmotorgen export crate handling KiCad IPC adapter + DXF.

pcbmotorgen-simulation-docs.description: API documentation for consuming the pcbmotorgen simulation crate handling physics and simulation.
